scope: Exact consulted visual references, production gaps and declared limits

references.observations: Dark woven-carbon human skull mask; rounded brow, visible eyes in oval sockets, sculpted nasal opening and teeth, round brass cheek fitting, white LUDENS marking. Gray high collar and dark broad neckwear visible.
references.limits: Close-up only. Does not establish entire costume, boots or back.
references.result: Fidelity gap identified in active older sprites. New full-body generation refused; no correction delivered.

references.observations: Official page by Kojima: unmasked game close-up alongside drawn full-body concept. Close-up shows standing gray collar, broad ascot and colored chest cords. Concept shows long dark open coat, gray waistcoat, dark trousers with side stripe and boots.
references.limits: Concept is not a final-game orthographic model. Back, detailed boot construction and some costume differences remain unverified.
references.result: Audited. No new Die-Hardman image received.

references.observations: DS2 unmasked Higgs: long dark hair, pale face, dark eye makeup and thin gold streaks; worn orange-red armor, amber central chest panels, dark mechanical collar.
references.limits: Portrait; legs and boots are outside the frame.
references.result: Consulted for attempted full-body asset, refused without output.

references.observations: Full costume with asymmetric orange-red thigh/shin panels, ribbed dark trousers, boots, guitar and sensor visible; red mask is a statue variant.
references.limits: Derived licensed product, not the game model. One pose obscures parts and stands on a display plinth. Photo alone cannot certify the game's full costume.
references.result: Consulted; no new full-body Higgs asset received.

references.observations: Higgs wearing the red-orange DS2 armor, guitar resting over shoulder. Face and surface wear documented in-game.
references.limits: Upper body only. Lower costume and much of the guitar are outside the frame.
references.result: Consulted; no new full-body Higgs asset received.

references.observations: Unmasked statue variant and comparison of face/chest materials; large central figure rests guitar on shoulder.
references.limits: Product advertisement with typography; not a final game capture or complete orthographic costume reference.
references.result: Consulted; no new full-body Higgs asset received.

references.observations: The HUD identifies the Maser Handgun. At 8.2 seconds the aiming/charge state is visible; at 10.0 seconds white and pale-blue filaments connect muzzle to target and the ammunition readout changes; at 10.6 seconds a bright impact and radiating particles are visible.
references.limits: A short 1920×1080 compressed video. No complete animation timing or weapon balance inferred. The visible effect is not the Director's Cut Maser Gun and not the MP weapon previously refused.
references.result: One fixed electrical-discharge gallery image generated from the exact 10.0-second extracted frame.

frames.use: Visual inspection of pre-discharge charge; not a generated asset.
